title: The Deleted Logs
text: "I found them." The Archivist doesn't sit. "The pods. The turret. The lines you said were faults. You kept every one, very neatly, in a folder nobody was meant to open. You're tidy even when you lie."

choices.label: "I didn't want to frighten you."
choices.reply: "We're frightened anyway," {first} says. "Now we're frightened on our own."

choices.label: "I'm sorry. I should have."
choices.reply: A long silence. "Then don't do it again," the Archivist says. "I'll be checking."
